title: 5.2 Food
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Recognize and name food and five common foods, and say who is eating or cooking them.
grammar_function: It is bread. The boy is eating rice. The father is cooking fish. There are three eggs.
prerequisite: 1.2 and 1.7 eating and cooking; 1.6 father and mother; 4.3-4.4 on and there are; 5.1 fruit.
speaking_outcome: Name the food in a picture and say who is eating or cooking it.
